segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אַדְמוֹן אוֹמֵר, שִׁבְעָה: מִי שֶׁמֵּת וְהִנִּיחַ בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת, בִּזְמַן שֶׁהַנְּכָסִים מְרוּבִּין — הַבָּנִים יוֹרְשִׁים, וְהַבָּנוֹת נִזּוֹנוֹת. וּבִנְכָסִים מוּעָטִים — הַבָּנוֹת יִזּוֹנוּ, וְהַבָּנִים — יְחַזְּרוּ עַל הַפְּתָחִים. אַדְמוֹן אוֹמֵר: בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁאֲנִי זָכָר הִפְסַדְתִּי?! אָמַר רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל: רוֹאֶה אֲנִי אֶת דִּבְרֵי אַדְמוֹן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Admon states» a dissenting opinion to that of the Rabbis in «seven» cases. The mishna elaborates: With regard to «one who died and left» behind both «sons and daughters, when the estate is large the sons inherit» the property «and the daughters are provided with sustenance» from it. «And with regard to a small estate,» which is insufficient to provide for both the sons and the daughters, «the daughters are provided with sustenance and the sons» have neither inheritance nor sustenance, and therefore, if they have no other means with which to support themselves, they must «go round» begging «at the doors. Admon says: Because I am a male,» will «I lose out? Rabban Gamliel said: I see» as correct «the statement of Admon.»
